en.text: We need sufficient temperament information, the required health and safety information, and an eligibility outcome that permits a personalised plan.

en.text: If information is missing or professional review is required, your purchased plan right stays on hold and is not used up while the outcome is unresolved.

af.text: As inligting ontbreek of professionele hersiening nodig is, bly jou gekoopte planreg voorbehou en word dit nie opgebruik terwyl die uitkoms nog nie vasstaan nie.

en.text: A personalised plan is not guaranteed by payment alone. It does not replace individual medical, psychological or dietetic care, and it cannot promise a particular weight or health result.

en.text: Will I get my plan as soon as I pay?

en.text: Not automatically. Payment must first be verified, and a personalised plan can be delivered only after the required information and safety checks are satisfied.

copy_items.meaning: General Wellness and final outcome FAQ question

en.text: What if a personalised plan is not appropriate for me?

af.text: Wat as ’n persoonlike plan nie vir my geskik is nie?

en.text: If only General Wellness guidance is appropriate, you may use an approved General Wellness pathway without using up the purchased personalised-plan right. You can choose to keep that right or request a refund for its recorded purchase allocation. A final outcome that cannot provide the plan leads to the applicable plan-component refund.

af.text: As slegs algemene welstandsleiding geskik is, kan jy ’n goedgekeurde algemene welstandspad volg sonder om jou gekoopte reg op ’n persoonlike plan op te gebruik. Jy kan kies om daardie reg te behou of ’n terugbetaling van die vasgelegde aankooptoedeling vir die plan aan te vra. ’n Finale uitkoms waar die plan nie voorsien kan word nie, lei tot die toepaslike terugbetaling vir die plandeel.

en.text: If your outcome is General Wellness only, you have one 14-day choice period from the notice explaining your options. If you do not choose in that period, the recorded plan-component amount is refunded and that plan right closes. Keeping it does not guarantee that you will qualify for a personalised plan later.

af.text: Vrae oor die bundel

en.text: Can I complete the included assessment later?

af.text: Kan ek die ingeslote assessering later voltooi?

copy_items.meaning: Conditional fast-onboarding without consuming paid digital assessment

en.text: Where an approved temperament entry path allows it, you may begin with existing temperament information and complete the included digital assessment later. Earlier self-reported or book-derived information is not a paid digital assessment result.

af.text: Waar ’n goedgekeurde manier om temperamentinligting te verskaf dit toelaat, kan jy met bestaande temperamentinligting begin en die ingeslote digitale assessering later voltooi. Inligting wat jy self aandui of uit die boek verkry het, is nie ’n betaalde digitale assesseringsresultaat nie.

en.text: What happens if I cannot receive a personalised plan?

af.text: Wat gebeur as ek nie ’n persoonlike plan kan ontvang nie?

en.text: The outcome determines whether your plan right stays on hold, you can choose to keep it or request a refund, or the plan part must be refunded. Any refund of that part uses the amount recorded for the plan in your accepted bundle order, not the current standalone plan price. A valid, separately delivered assessment is not automatically cancelled.

af.text: Die uitkoms bepaal of jou planreg voorbehou bly, of jy kan kies om dit te behou of ’n terugbetaling aan te vra, of of die plandeel terugbetaal moet word. ’n Terugbetaling vir dié deel gebruik die bedrag wat vir die plan in jou aanvaarde bundelbestelling vasgelê is, nie die huidige prys van ’n afsonderlike plan nie. ’n Geldige assessering wat afsonderlik beskikbaar gestel is, word nie outomaties gekanselleer nie.

en.text: How is the saving worked out?

af.text: Hoe word die besparing bereken?

en.text: The saving is the difference between the applicable separate list prices and the bundle price. Promotions and the accepted order amounts are shown separately before payment.

af.text: Die besparing is die verskil tussen die toepaslike afsonderlike lyspryse en die bundelprys. Promosies en die bedrae van die aanvaarde bestelling word afsonderlik voor betaling gewys.
